idea-plugin.name: Jype
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ support for Jype, the javac extension that propagates generic parameters declared at the package level.
  • Resolution of types declared by @TypeSystem and its inherited systems
  • Completion for resolved types
  • Completion for inherited packages and overridden type names
  • Renaming declarations and their usages, with undo support
  • Annotation diagnostics and cast analysis based on bounds
  • Partial generic inheritance diagnostics for source and compiled libraries
  • Structural configuration of the local Maven POM, with undo support
The engine is still required for compilation. The editor's virtual types represent bounds, not all compiler transformations.
